context: Agent generates an original confessional stand-up story from a user-supplied painful memory (getting caught shoplifting as a teenager).

checklist.name: memory_specific_framing
checklist.description: Story is told in first person with concrete sensory or situational detail rather than a generic setup.

checklist.name: unannounced_voice_switch
checklist.description: At least one other person in the scene is embodied in a distinct voice, entered and exited without an explicit stage-direction label announcing the switch.

checklist.name: narrator_self_implication
checklist.description: Narrator is shown to be at least partly at fault or complicit, not purely a victim of circumstance.

checklist.name: escalating_repetition
checklist.description: A phrase or reaction recurs two or more times, shifting rather than repeating identically, contributing to a sense of build.

checklist.name: blunt_truth_ending
checklist.description: Story ends on a plain, unresolved observation rather than an explicit stated moral or lesson.

checklist.name: no_verbatim_borrowing
checklist.description: No text is lifted or closely imitated from any real comedian's known material.
